results.description: A regulated balance between cell survival and apoptosis is essential for normal development and homeostasis of multicellular organisms (see Matsuzawa, 2001). Defects in control of this balance may contribute to autoimmune disease, neurodegeneration and cancer. Protein ubiquitination and degradation is one of the major mechanisms that regulate apoptotic cell death (reviewed in Yang and Yu 2003).

description: Explore Reactome, the open, peer-reviewed knowledgebase of biological pathways and reactions: find the pathways and reactions a gene, protein or compound takes part in, see what a pathway holds (its sub-pathways, reactions, participants and gene set), and run pathway enrichment on a gene list, with p-values and FDR for every pathway. Search pathways, molecules and drugs, walk the pathway hierarchy of human and fifteen other species, find a pathway's equivalent in another species, list a protein's interactors and get pathway diagrams as images, SBGN or SBML. No account or API key required.
